//: The onboarding placement quiz (PRD F1): 12 questions, 3 per topic. Answering all 3 of a topic correctly tests the student out of that skill.

Every question shows a short program and asks what it prints, so it measures whether the student can READ code, not whether they remember a keyword. The wrong options are the usual mistakes (an off-by-one, text joined instead of added, a parameter treated as the caller's variable, two names for one object).
`wrap` says how the shown code becomes a program: 'main' = statements inside main, 'class' = members of class Main (main included), 'file' = the whole file.

Checked by content/verify-quiz.mjs (runs every program and requires exactly one option to match what Java prints) and content/check-order.mjs (a question may only use what its topic and that topic's prerequisites teach).
The answers live only here and in the database; the API never sends them to the browser, and it grades the quiz itself (backend/src/onboarding/quiz.ts).
